title: Redacted token API response for SQLAlchemy connection failure
classification: A real SQLAlchemy/psycopg2 OperationalError raised during PostgreSQL connection establishment is converted to the generic native API error envelope.

verification.result: passed: 14 tests; no test database or external network used
verification.fault: The token-list adapter opens a SQLAlchemy PostgreSQL engine to an unavailable loopback port. Psycopg2's refused connection becomes SQLAlchemy OperationalError before any query or database mutation.

assertions: the configured production ASGI exception handlers return HTTP 500 with error_code internal
the response uses the generic user-facing error message
connection diagnostics and synthetic endpoint identity are absent from the response
limits: Only token listing exercises the real driver failure; create and revoke continue to use injected adapter failures in the neighboring regression.
This does not simulate a failed connection to the configured application database or provide paired exact-image response parity.
